title: Chemical short-range order increases the phonon heat conductivity in a refractory high-entropy alloy

recollection.mechanism: guess: increased phonon mean free path due to reduced scattering

score.note: The recollection identifies varying chemical short-range order, but only at the level implied by the title and without the Monte Carlo induction or HfTi/TiZr clustering. It misses the B2-like structures and percolative cluster pathways. The reduced-scattering/increased-mean-free-path mechanism is directionally correct and goes beyond the title, though it omits percolation and phonon-DOS changes. It gives no numerical result such as the ~12% conductivity increase.
